newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM palladium retreats from daily limit highs.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM palladium retreats from daily limit highs.

text.p: Most Tokyo palladium futures reversed early gains to tread lower in early Friday morning trade after the June, August and October Tokyo palladium futures surged by their 24 yen per gram daily limit at the open on Thursday, traders said.

"The tight physical market helped some palladium futures stay at their daily limits at the open after prices were limit-high on Thursday," one trader said. "But futures except for the spot June contract retreated quickly amid caution that prices were too high," he said. Benchmark April palladium was off 13 yen at 600 yen in early morning trade.
